purpose: Diagnose PFFDTD spatial representation, source/receiver interpolation stencil variation, and fixed frequency-neighborhood sensitivity without changing the canonical solver contract or scored 40/80 Hz acceptance.

spatial_representation.representation_kind: node-centered Cartesian grid with boundary-node indices bn_ixyz and per-boundary-node blocked-neighbor adjacency mask adj_bn; not voxel-cell-center occupancy
spatial_representation.air_domain_definition: connected component of grid nodes reachable from the actual source stencil nodes through Cartesian nearest-neighbor edges not blocked by adj_bn; source stencil nodes must belong to one component
spatial_representation.interior_node_count_definition: reachable air-domain nodes excluding boundary nodes
spatial_representation.boundary_node_count_definition: reachable air-domain nodes whose linear index appears in bn_ixyz
spatial_representation.sloped_staircase_sample_definition: unique blocked Cartesian node-neighbor edges whose segment intersects an exact triangulation of the R120B ceiling polygon; sample position is the midpoint between the two grid nodes, representing the staircase control-volume face center implied by the blocked adjacency
spatial_representation.plane_distance_definition: signed orthogonal distance from each staircase face-center sample to the exact ceiling plane, using a deterministic unit normal from the first non-collinear ceiling vertices

classification.rule: If either physical discrete-volume relative error or physical sloped-plane RMS normal-distance error at 12 PPW is greater than its 10 PPW value, classify NON_MONOTONIC; otherwise classify MONOTONIC.

interpolation_stencil.authority: bsxfun/pffdtd python/fdtd/sim_comms.py SimComms.get_linear_interp_weights at pinned commit
interpolation_stencil.source_actual_authority: comms_out.h5 in_ixyz plus source in_sigs[:,0] normalized to unit sum; this reconstructs the actual trilinear source weights after PFFDTD setup without changing execution
interpolation_stencil.fractional_cell_coordinate_definition: (position - lower_corner_node_position)/h for the unique lower/upper Cartesian bracket used by the eight-node stencil

frequency_neighborhood.operator: same native finite-record direct DTFT P_T/Q_T left-rectangle operator as canonical execution, evaluated from the same raw pressure/source record; no additional solver execution
frequency_neighborhood.worsening_rule: worsening at frequency f iff d_10_12(f) > d_8_10(f)
